note: Names are Board-approved. Notes are not translated yet: 'note' repeats the English note because the schema requires one (noteLang: en).

obs.2026.prabodhini-ekadashi.name: देवउठनी (प्रबोधिनी) एकादशी
obs.2026.prabodhini-ekadashi.note: Marks the end of Chaturmas. In Maharashtra, many devotees walk to Pandharpur for Kartiki Ekadashi; Vaishnava calendars observe it on 21 November.

obs.2026.tulsi-vivah.name: तुलसी विवाह
obs.2026.tulsi-vivah.note: The ceremonial marriage of the tulsi plant to Vishnu, celebrated in many homes. Families keep it on different days in this week.

obs.2026.kartik-purnima.name: कार्तिक पूर्णिमा और देव दीपावली
obs.2026.kartik-purnima.note: The full moon of Kartik. Many people take a ritual bath and light lamps; in Varanasi the ghats are lit for Dev Deepawali.

obs.2026.guru-nanak-gurpurab.name: गुरु नानक गुरपुरब (प्रकाश पर्व)
obs.2026.guru-nanak-gurpurab.note: The birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the first Sikh Guru. Gurdwaras hold kirtan, prabhat pheris and langar open to all.

obs.2026.advent-sunday.name: आगमन काल का पहला रविवार
obs.2026.advent-sunday.note: The start of the Christian liturgical year and four weeks of preparation for Christmas.

obs.2026.st-francis-xavier.name: संत फ्रांसिस ज़ेवियर का पर्व
obs.2026.st-francis-xavier.note: Goa's patron saint, whose relics are kept at the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa. Pilgrims of many faiths attend the feast.

obs.2026.hanukkah.name: हनुक्का
obs.2026.hanukkah.note: The eight-night Jewish festival of lights, remembering the rededication of the Temple in Jerusalem. A lamp is lit each evening, from 4 to 12 December.

obs.2026.mahaparinirvan-din.name: महापरिनिर्वाण दिवस
obs.2026.mahaparinirvan-din.note: The death anniversary of Dr B. R. Ambedkar in 1956. Large numbers, many of them Ambedkarite Buddhists, gather at Chaitya Bhoomi in Mumbai to pay respects.

obs.2026.bodhi-day.name: बोधि दिवस
obs.2026.bodhi-day.note: Marks the Buddha's enlightenment in Japanese and some other Mahayana traditions. Theravada Buddhists remember it on Vesak, in April or May.

obs.2026.gita-jayanti.name: गीता जयंती
obs.2026.gita-jayanti.note: Remembers the day the Bhagavad Gita is traditionally said to have been spoken. It falls on Mokshada Ekadashi; many read or recite the Gita.

obs.2026.datta-jayanti.name: दत्त जयंती
obs.2026.datta-jayanti.note: The birth anniversary of Dattatreya, on Margashirsha Purnima. Widely observed in Maharashtra and Karnataka at Datta temples.

obs.2026.hazrat-ali-birthday.name: हज़रत अली का जन्मदिवस
obs.2026.hazrat-ali-birthday.note: Remembers the birth of Ali ibn Abi Talib, on 13 Rajab. The date depends on the sighting of the moon.

obs.2026.christmas.name: क्रिसमस (बड़ा दिन)
obs.2026.christmas.note: Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus with midnight Mass, carols and time with family.

obs.2027.lohri.name: लोहड़ी
obs.2027.lohri.note: A winter harvest festival of Punjab, celebrated around a bonfire on the eve of Maghi. Some calendars list it on 14 January.

obs.2027.makar-sankranti.name: मकर संक्रांति
obs.2027.makar-sankranti.note: The sun's move into Makara (Capricorn). Many observe it on 14 January and others on the morning of 15 January; in Maharashtra, til-gul is shared.

obs.2027.pongal.name: पोंगल
obs.2027.pongal.note: The Tamil harvest festival. Rice is boiled in new pots until it overflows, as thanks for the harvest.

obs.2027.guru-gobind-singh-prakash.name: गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी का प्रकाश पर्व
obs.2027.guru-gobind-singh-prakash.note: The birth anniversary of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the tenth Sikh Guru. Some Sikh calendars mark it on a different January date.

obs.2027.thaipusam.name: थाईपूसम
obs.2027.thaipusam.note: A Tamil festival for Murugan on the full moon of the month of Thai. Devotees offer prayers, and some carry kavadi in procession.

obs.2027.republic-day.name: गणतंत्र दिवस
obs.2027.republic-day.note: The day the Constitution of India came into force in 1950.

obs.2027.ramadan-begins.name: रमज़ान की शुरुआत (अपेक्षित)
obs.2027.ramadan-begins.note: The month of fasting from dawn to sunset begins. The start depends on the sighting of the new moon.

obs.2027.ash-wednesday.name: राख बुधवार (ऐश वेडनेसडे)
obs.2027.ash-wednesday.note: The first day of Lent, a season of prayer and fasting before Easter.

obs.2027.ganesh-jayanti.name: गणेश जयंती (माघी)
obs.2027.ganesh-jayanti.note: The birth anniversary of Ganesha in the month of Magha, observed especially in Maharashtra and at Ganesha temples.

obs.2027.vasant-panchami.name: वसंत पंचमी
obs.2027.vasant-panchami.note: Welcomes spring. Many honour Saraswati, the goddess of learning, and some children begin their first letters on this day.

obs.2027.ratha-saptami.name: रथ सप्तमी
obs.2027.ratha-saptami.note: A day for honouring Surya, the sun, at sunrise.

obs.2027.guru-ravidas-jayanti.name: गुरु रविदास जयंती
obs.2027.guru-ravidas-jayanti.note: The birth anniversary of Sant Guru Ravidas, whose hymns are part of the Guru Granth Sahib. Observed on Magha Purnima.

obs.2027.jamat-ul-vida.name: जमात-उल-विदा (अपेक्षित)
obs.2027.jamat-ul-vida.note: The last Friday of Ramadan, marked by special congregational prayers. The date depends on the moon.

obs.2027.maha-shivaratri.name: महाशिवरात्रि
obs.2027.maha-shivaratri.note: A night for Shiva. Many keep a fast and a night vigil with prayer.

obs.2027.eid-al-fitr.name: ईद-उल-फ़ित्र (अपेक्षित)
obs.2027.eid-al-fitr.note: Marks the end of Ramadan with prayers, charity and meals with family and friends. It may fall on 11 March, depending on the moon.

obs.2027.holika-dahan.name: होलिका दहन
obs.2027.holika-dahan.note: Bonfires are lit on the eve of Holi. Devotees recount the story of Prahlad's faith.

obs.2027.holi.name: होली
obs.2027.holi.note: The festival of colours, welcoming spring. In some states the public holiday is on 23 March.

obs.2027.good-friday.name: गुड फ्राइडे
obs.2027.good-friday.note: Christians remember the crucifixion of Jesus with prayer and quiet services.

obs.2027.easter.name: ईस्टर
obs.2027.easter.note: Christians celebrate the resurrection of Jesus.
